14	class TurnEmbedding(nn.Module):
15	
16	    def __init__(self):
17	        super().__init__()
18	        half_dim = TURN_EMBED_DIM // 2
19	        num_buckets = MAX_TURN_DISTANCE + 1
20	        self.distance_embed = nn.Embedding(num_buckets, half_dim)
21	        self.index_embed = nn.Embedding(num_buckets, half_dim)
22	
23	    def forward(self, turn_distance, turn_index):
24	        td = turn_distance.clamp(0, MAX_TURN_DISTANCE)
25	        ti = turn_index.clamp(0, MAX_TURN_DISTANCE)
26	        return torch.cat([self.distance_embed(td), self.index_embed(ti)], dim=-1)

29	class GateNetwork(nn.Module):
30	
31	    def __init__(self, hidden_dim, turn_embedding, init_bias=5.0):
32	        super().__init__()
33	        self.down_proj = nn.Linear(hidden_dim, LORA_RANK, bias=False)
34	        self.turn_embedding = turn_embedding
35	        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(LORA_RANK + TURN_EMBED_DIM, GATE_HIDDEN_DIM)
36	        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(GATE_HIDDEN_DIM, 1)
37	        self.fc2.bias.data.fill_(init_bias)
38	
39	    def forward(self, hidden_state, turn_features):
40	        down = self.down_proj(hidden_state)
41	        turn_emb = self.turn_embedding(
42	            turn_features["turn_distance"],
43	            turn_features["turn_index"],
44	        )
45	        while turn_emb.dim() < down.dim():
46	            turn_emb = turn_emb.unsqueeze(0)
47	        if turn_emb.shape[0] == 1 and down.shape[0] > 1:
48	            turn_emb = turn_emb.expand(down.shape[0], -1, -1)
49	        combined = torch.cat([down, turn_emb], dim=-1)
50	        return torch.sigmoid(self.fc2(torch.relu(self.fc1(combined))))

53	class UniformGateNetwork(nn.Module):
54	
55	    def __init__(self, hidden_dim, init_bias=5.0):
56	        super().__init__()
57	        self.down_proj = nn.Linear(hidden_dim, LORA_RANK, bias=False)
58	        self.constant_vector = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(TURN_EMBED_DIM))
59	        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(LORA_RANK + TURN_EMBED_DIM, GATE_HIDDEN_DIM)
60	        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(GATE_HIDDEN_DIM, 1)
61	        self.fc2.bias.data.fill_(init_bias)
62	
63	    def forward(self, hidden_state):
64	        h = self.down_proj(hidden_state)
65	        c = self.constant_vector.unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0).expand(
66	            hidden_state.size(0), hidden_state.size(1), -1
67	        )
68	        combined = torch.cat([h, c], dim=-1)
69	        return torch.sigmoid(self.fc2(torch.relu(self.fc1(combined))))

72	class ThreadGatedModel(nn.Module):
73	
74	    def __init__(self, model_name=MODEL_NAME, gate_type="threadgate", init_bias=2.0, device_map="auto"):
75	        super().__init__()
76	        self.gate_type = gate_type
77	
78	        self.base_model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
79	            model_name, torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16, device_map=device_map,
80	        )
81	        for param in self.base_model.parameters():
82	            param.requires_grad = False
83	
84	        hidden_dim = self.base_model.config.hidden_size
85	        num_layers = self.base_model.config.num_hidden_layers
86	        self.num_layers = num_layers
87	
88	        if gate_type == "none":
89	            self.gates = None
90	        elif gate_type == "threadgate":
91	            self.turn_embedding = TurnEmbedding()
92	            self.gates = nn.ModuleList([
93	                GateNetwork(hidden_dim, self.turn_embedding, init_bias)
94	                for _ in range(num_layers)
95	            ])
96	        else:
97	            self.gates = nn.ModuleList([
98	                UniformGateNetwork(hidden_dim, init_bias)
99	                for _ in range(num_layers)
100	            ])
101	
102	        if self.gates is not None:
103	            for i, layer in enumerate(self.base_model.model.layers):
104	                device = next(layer.parameters()).device
105	                self.gates[i].to(device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
106	            if gate_type == "threadgate":
107	                device = next(self.gates[0].parameters()).device
108	                self.turn_embedding.to(device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
109	
110	        self._gate_values = {}
111	        self._gate_values_with_grad = {}
112	        self._current_turn_features = None
113	
114	        self._hooks = []
115	        if self.gate_type != "none":
116	            for i, layer in enumerate(self.base_model.model.layers):
117	                self._hooks.append(layer.register_forward_hook(self._make_hook(i)))
118	
119	    def _make_hook(self, layer_idx):
120	        def hook(module, input, output):
121	            layer_input = input[0]
122	
123	            if isinstance(output, tuple):
124	                layer_output = output[0]
125	            else:
126	                layer_output = output
127	
128	            if self.gate_type == "threadgate":
129	                gate = self.gates[layer_idx](layer_input, self._current_turn_features)
130	            else:
131	                gate = self.gates[layer_idx](layer_input)
132	
133	            f_x = layer_output - layer_input
134	            gated = layer_input + gate * f_x
135	            self._gate_values[layer_idx] = gate.detach()
136	            self._gate_values_with_grad[layer_idx] = gate
137	
138	            if isinstance(output, tuple):
139	                return (gated,) + output[1:]
140	            return gated
141	
142	        return hook
143	
144	    def forward(self, input_ids, attention_mask=None, labels=None, turn_features=None, **kwargs):
145	        if self.gate_type == "threadgate" and turn_features is not None:
146	            device = next(self.gates[0].parameters()).device
147	            self._current_turn_features = {
148	                k: v.to(device) if isinstance(v, torch.Tensor) else v
149	                for k, v in turn_features.items()
150	            }
151	        else:
152	            self._current_turn_features = None
153	
154	        outputs = self.base_model(
155	            input_ids=input_ids,
156	            attention_mask=attention_mask,
157	            labels=labels,
158	            **kwargs,
159	        )
160	        return outputs
161	
162	    def get_gate_values(self, with_grad=False):
163	        if self.gate_type == "none":
164	            return {i: torch.tensor(1.0) for i in range(self.num_layers)}
165	        if with_grad:
166	            return dict(self._gate_values_with_grad)
167	        return dict(self._gate_values)
168	
169	    def trainable_parameters(self):
170	        for name, param in self.named_parameters():
171	            if param.requires_grad:
172	                yield name, param
173	
174	    def count_parameters(self):
175	        total = sum(p.numel() for p in self.parameters())
176	        trainable = sum(p.numel() for p in self.parameters() if p.requires_grad)
177	        ratio = trainable / total if total > 0 else 0.0
178	        return total, trainable, ratio

183	    model = ThreadGatedModel(MODEL_NAME, gate_type, init_bias, device_map)

import argparse
import os
import sys
import json
import time
import random

import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
import numpy as np
from torch.optim import AdamW
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, Dataset
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, get_cosine_schedule_with_warmup
from peft import LoraConfig, get_peft_model
from datasets import load_from_disk

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
from threadgate import ThreadGatedModel
from gar import GARMeasurer, compute_gar_loss
from turn_utils import detect_turn_boundaries, build_turn_features
from config import (
    MODEL_NAME, LORA_RANK, GAR_EPSILON, GAR_LAMBDA, LEARNING_RATE,
    BATCH_SIZE, GRADIENT_ACCUMULATION, MAX_SEQ_LEN, NUM_EPOCHS, SEED,
    INIT_BIAS, GAR_LOSS_MODE, GAR_TARGET, LAMBDA_GATE_DIV, MIN_GATE_STD,
)


def set_seed(seed):
    random.seed(seed)
    np.random.seed(seed)
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)


class MultiTurnDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, data_path, tokenizer, max_seq_len=2048):
        self.ds = load_from_disk(data_path)
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_seq_len = max_seq_len

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.ds)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        messages = self.ds[idx]["messages"]
        text = self.tokenizer.apply_chat_template(messages, tokenize=False)
        encoding = self.tokenizer(
            text, truncation=True, max_length=self.max_seq_len, return_tensors="pt"
        )
        input_ids = encoding.input_ids.squeeze(0)

        boundaries = detect_turn_boundaries(input_ids, self.tokenizer)
        turn_feats = build_turn_features(input_ids, self.tokenizer)

        labels = input_ids.clone()
        labels[:] = -100
        for turn in boundaries["turns"]:
            if turn["role"] == "assistant":
                labels[turn["content_start"]:turn["content_end"]] = input_ids[turn["content_start"]:turn["content_end"]]

        return {
            "input_ids": input_ids,
            "labels": labels,
            "turn_features": turn_feats,
            "goal_positions": boundaries["goal_token_positions"],
            "assistant_last_positions": boundaries["assistant_last_token_positions"],
        }


def collate_fn(batch):
    item = batch[0]
    return {
        "input_ids": item["input_ids"].unsqueeze(0),
        "labels": item["labels"].unsqueeze(0),
        "turn_features": item["turn_features"],
        "goal_positions": item["goal_positions"],
        "assistant_last_positions": item["assistant_last_positions"],
    }


def log_gate_stats(model, global_step, detailed=False):
    gate_values = model.get_gate_values()
    if not gate_values:
        return
    per_layer_gates = []
    for layer_idx in sorted(gate_values.keys()):
        g = gate_values[layer_idx].mean().item()
        per_layer_gates.append(g)
    gate_mean = sum(per_layer_gates) / len(per_layer_gates)
    gate_std = (sum((g - gate_mean)**2 for g in per_layer_gates) / len(per_layer_gates)) ** 0.5
    gate_min = min(per_layer_gates)
    gate_max = max(per_layer_gates)
    print(f"[GATE] step={global_step} mean={gate_mean:.4f} std={gate_std:.4f} min={gate_min:.4f} max={gate_max:.4f}")
    if detailed:
        layer_str = " ".join([f"L{i}:{g:.3f}" for i, g in enumerate(per_layer_gates)])
        print(f"[GATE-PROFILE] step={global_step} {layer_str}")


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--gate-type", type=str, default="threadgate", choices=["threadgate", "uniform", "none"])
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=SEED)
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", type=str, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--data-dir", type=str, default="/root/turn_residual_gating/data/ultrachat_8k")
    parser.add_argument("--lambda-gar", type=float, default=GAR_LAMBDA)
    parser.add_argument("--max-seq-len", type=int, default=MAX_SEQ_LEN)
    parser.add_argument("--epochs", type=int, default=NUM_EPOCHS)
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--max-steps", type=int, default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--batch-size", type=int, default=BATCH_SIZE)
    parser.add_argument("--lr", type=float, default=LEARNING_RATE)
    parser.add_argument("--grad-accum", type=int, default=GRADIENT_ACCUMULATION)
    parser.add_argument("--gar-loss-mode", type=str, default=GAR_LOSS_MODE, choices=["pairwise", "cumulative", "maximize", "hinge_target", "smooth_saturation", "mse_target"])
    parser.add_argument("--lambda-gate-div", type=float, default=LAMBDA_GATE_DIV)
    parser.add_argument("--min-gate-std", type=float, default=MIN_GATE_STD)
    parser.add_argument("--gar-epsilon", type=float, default=GAR_EPSILON)
    parser.add_argument("--init-bias", type=float, default=INIT_BIAS)
    parser.add_argument("--gar-target", type=float, default=GAR_TARGET)
    parser.add_argument("--gate-lr-multiplier", type=float, default=1.0)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    set_seed(args.seed)
    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    print(f"Device: {device}")
    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        print(f"GPU: {torch.cuda.get_device_name(0)}")
        print(f"VRAM: {torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).total_memory / 1e9:.1f} GB")

    print(f"Gate type: {args.gate_type}")
    print(f"Loading model: {MODEL_NAME}")

    model = ThreadGatedModel(
        MODEL_NAME,
        gate_type=args.gate_type,
        init_bias=args.init_bias,
        device_map="auto",
    )

    lora_config = LoraConfig(
        r=LORA_RANK,
        lora_alpha=32,
        target_modules=["q_proj", "v_proj"],
        lora_dropout=0.05,
        bias="none",
        task_type="CAUSAL_LM",
    )
    model.base_model = get_peft_model(model.base_model, lora_config)
    model.base_model.print_trainable_parameters()

    model.base_model.gradient_checkpointing_enable()

    original_model = model.base_model.base_model.model
    original_model.config._attn_implementation = "eager"
    original_model.config.attn_implementation = "eager"
    for layer in original_model.model.layers:
        layer.self_attn._attn_implementation = "eager"

    measurer = GARMeasurer(original_model, measure_only=False)

    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(MODEL_NAME)
    if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
        tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token

    print(f"Loading data from {args.data_dir}")
    dataset = MultiTurnDataset(args.data_dir, tokenizer, max_seq_len=args.max_seq_len)
    dataloader = DataLoader(dataset, batch_size=1, shuffle=True, collate_fn=collate_fn, num_workers=0)
    print(f"Dataset size: {len(dataset)}")

    gate_params = []
    lora_params = []
    for name, param in model.named_parameters():
        if param.requires_grad:
            if 'gates.' in name or 'turn_embedding.' in name:
                gate_params.append(param)
            else:
                lora_params.append(param)

    print(f"LoRA params: {len(lora_params)}, Gate params: {len(gate_params)}")
    print(f"Gate LR multiplier: {args.gate_lr_multiplier} (gate lr = {args.lr * args.gate_lr_multiplier})")

    if gate_params:
        param_groups = [
            {"params": lora_params, "lr": args.lr},
            {"params": gate_params, "lr": args.lr * args.gate_lr_multiplier},
        ]
    else:
        param_groups = [{"params": lora_params, "lr": args.lr}]

    optimizer = AdamW(param_groups, weight_decay=0.01)

    total_steps = len(dataloader) * args.epochs // args.grad_accum
    if args.dry_run:
        total_steps = 5
    if args.max_steps is not None:
        total_steps = args.max_steps
    scheduler = get_cosine_schedule_with_warmup(
        optimizer,
        num_warmup_steps=max(1, total_steps // 10),
        num_training_steps=total_steps,
    )

    print(f"Total training steps: {total_steps}")
    print(f"Gradient accumulation: {args.grad_accum}")
    print(f"Lambda GAR: {args.lambda_gar}")
    print(f"Lambda Gate Div: {args.lambda_gate_div}")
    print(f"Min Gate Std: {args.min_gate_std}")
    print("=" * 60)

    total_params, trainable_params, ratio = model.count_parameters()
    print(f"Total params: {total_params:,}")
    print(f"Trainable params: {trainable_params:,} ({ratio*100:.2f}%)")
    print("=" * 60)

    model.train()
    start_time = time.time()
    global_step = 0
    gate_grad_observed = False
    optimizer.zero_grad()

    for epoch in range(args.epochs):
        epoch_loss = 0.0
        epoch_ntp = 0.0
        epoch_gar = 0.0
        epoch_div = 0.0
        num_batches = 0

        for step, batch in enumerate(dataloader):
            if args.dry_run and global_step >= 5:
                break
            if args.max_steps is not None and global_step >= args.max_steps:
                break

            input_ids = batch["input_ids"].to(device)
            labels = batch["labels"].to(device)
            turn_features = {
                k: v.to(device) if isinstance(v, torch.Tensor) else v
                for k, v in batch["turn_features"].items()
            }

            with measurer.measure():
                outputs = model(
                    input_ids,
                    labels=labels,
                    turn_features=turn_features,
                    output_attentions=True,
                )

            l_ntp = outputs.loss

            goal_pos = batch["goal_positions"]
            assistant_pos = batch["assistant_last_positions"]

            if len(assistant_pos) >= 2 and len(goal_pos) > 0:
                gar_per_turn = []
                for pos in assistant_pos:
                    gar_val = measurer.compute_gar_differentiable(goal_pos, [pos])
                    gar_per_turn.append(gar_val)
                l_gar = compute_gar_loss(gar_per_turn, epsilon=args.gar_epsilon, mode=args.gar_loss_mode, target=args.gar_target)
            else:
                l_gar = torch.tensor(0.0, device=device, requires_grad=True)

            gate_values_grad = model.get_gate_values(with_grad=True)
            if gate_values_grad and args.lambda_gate_div > 0 and args.gate_type != "none":
                per_layer_means = []
                for layer_idx in sorted(gate_values_grad.keys()):
                    per_layer_means.append(gate_values_grad[layer_idx].mean())
                gate_means_tensor = torch.stack(per_layer_means)
                current_gate_std = gate_means_tensor.std()
                l_gate_div = F.relu(torch.tensor(args.min_gate_std, device=device) - current_gate_std)
            else:
                l_gate_div = torch.tensor(0.0, device=device)

            loss = l_ntp + args.lambda_gar * l_gar + args.lambda_gate_div * l_gate_div
            loss = loss / args.grad_accum
            loss.backward()

            if (step + 1) % args.grad_accum == 0 or args.dry_run:
                torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
                if not gate_grad_observed and model.gates is not None:
                    gate_grad_observed = any(
                        p.grad is not None and p.grad.abs().sum() > 0
                        for p in model.gates.parameters()
                    )
                optimizer.step()
                scheduler.step()
                optimizer.zero_grad()
                global_step += 1

                if global_step % 50 == 0:
                    log_gate_stats(model, global_step, detailed=(global_step % 100 == 0))

            epoch_loss += loss.item() * args.grad_accum
            epoch_ntp += l_ntp.item()
            epoch_gar += l_gar.item()
            epoch_div += l_gate_div.item()
            num_batches += 1

            if step % 50 == 0 or args.dry_run:
                mem_used = torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated() / 1e9 if torch.cuda.is_available() else 0
                gate_vals = model.get_gate_values()
                mean_gate = np.mean([g.mean().item() for g in gate_vals.values()]) if gate_vals else 0
                print(
                    f"Epoch {epoch} Step {step} | "
                    f"L_NTP={l_ntp.item():.4f} L_GAR={l_gar.item():.4f} L_DIV={l_gate_div.item():.4f} "
                    f"Loss={loss.item()*args.grad_accum:.4f} | "
                    f"Gate={mean_gate:.4f} | Mem={mem_used:.1f}GB"
                )
                if epoch == 0 and step == 0:
                    log_gate_stats(model, 0, detailed=True)

        if args.dry_run:
            break
        if args.max_steps is not None and global_step >= args.max_steps:
            break

        avg_loss = epoch_loss / max(num_batches, 1)
        avg_ntp = epoch_ntp / max(num_batches, 1)
        avg_gar = epoch_gar / max(num_batches, 1)
        avg_div = epoch_div / max(num_batches, 1)
        print(f"\nEpoch {epoch} done | Avg Loss={avg_loss:.4f} Avg NTP={avg_ntp:.4f} Avg GAR={avg_gar:.4f} Avg DIV={avg_div:.4f}")

        if not args.dry_run:
            ckpt_dir = os.path.join(args.output_dir, f"epoch_{epoch}")
            os.makedirs(ckpt_dir, exist_ok=True)
            model.base_model.save_pretrained(os.path.join(ckpt_dir, "lora"))
            if model.gates is not None:
                gate_state = {"gates": model.gates.state_dict()}
                if hasattr(model, "turn_embedding"):
                    gate_state["turn_embedding"] = model.turn_embedding.state_dict()
                torch.save(gate_state, os.path.join(ckpt_dir, "gate_params.pt"))
            print(f"Checkpoint saved to {ckpt_dir}")

    elapsed = time.time() - start_time
    print(f"\nTraining complete in {elapsed:.1f}s")

    log_gate_stats(model, global_step, detailed=True)

    os.makedirs(args.output_dir, exist_ok=True)
    model.base_model.save_pretrained(os.path.join(args.output_dir, "lora"))
    if model.gates is not None:
        gate_state = {"gates": model.gates.state_dict()}
        if hasattr(model, "turn_embedding"):
            gate_state["turn_embedding"] = model.turn_embedding.state_dict()
        torch.save(gate_state, os.path.join(args.output_dir, "gate_params.pt"))

    config_dict = {
        "gate_type": args.gate_type,
        "seed": args.seed,
        "epochs": args.epochs,
        "lr": args.lr,
        "lambda_gar": args.lambda_gar,

        "lambda_gate_div": args.lambda_gate_div,
        "min_gate_std": args.min_gate_std,

139	    """Register forward hooks on transformer layers for residual gating."""
140	    layers = _find_layers(model)
141	    hooks = []

152	    def make_hook(layer_idx):
153	        def hook(module, input, output):
154	            if gate_type == "threadgate" and turn_features_ref[0] is None:
155	                return output
156	
157	            layer_input = input[0]
158	            layer_output = output[0] if isinstance(output, tuple) else output
159	
160	            if gate_type == "threadgate":
161	                g = gates[layer_idx](layer_input, turn_features_ref[0])
162	            else:
163	                g = gates[layer_idx](layer_input)

165	            f_x = layer_output - layer_input

167	            gate_values[layer_idx] = g.detach()

169	            if isinstance(output, tuple):

171	            return gated
172	        return hook

174	    for i, layer in enumerate(layers):
175	        hooks.append(layer.register_forward_hook(make_hook(i)))

def _find_hf_model(model):
    """Find the HF CausalLM model (with .model.layers) in the model hierarchy."""
    if hasattr(model, "model") and hasattr(model.model, "layers"):
        return model
    try:
        inner = model.base_model.model
        if hasattr(inner, "model") and hasattr(inner.model, "layers"):
            return inner
    except AttributeError:
        pass
    raise ValueError("Cannot find HF model with .model.layers in hierarchy")


def _find_layers(model):
    return _find_hf_model(model).model.layers


def _extract_per_turn_gates(gate_values, turns):
    num_layers = len(gate_values)
    result = {}
    for t_idx, turn in enumerate(turns):
        start = turn["content_start"]
        end = turn["content_end"]
        if end <= start:
            continue
        turn_key = f"turn_{t_idx + 1}"
        layer_gates = {}
        for layer_idx in range(num_layers):
            g = gate_values[layer_idx]
            turn_g = g[0, start:end, 0].float()
            layer_gates[f"L{layer_idx}"] = round(float(turn_g.mean().item()), 4)
        result[turn_key] = layer_gates
    return result


def _compute_gate_dynamic_range(all_gate_profiles, num_layers):
    dynamic_range = {}
    for layer_idx in range(num_layers):
        lk = f"L{layer_idx}"
        first_vals = []
        last_vals = []
        last_turn_num = 0
        for profile in all_gate_profiles:
            turn_keys = sorted(profile.keys(), key=lambda k: int(k.split("_")[1]))
            if len(turn_keys) >= 2:
                first_vals.append(profile[turn_keys[0]][lk])
                last_vals.append(profile[turn_keys[-1]][lk])
                last_turn_num = max(last_turn_num, int(turn_keys[-1].split("_")[1]))
        if first_vals and last_vals:
            avg_f = round(float(np.mean(first_vals)), 4)
            avg_l = round(float(np.mean(last_vals)), 4)
            dynamic_range[lk] = {
                "turn1": avg_f,
                f"turn{last_turn_num}": avg_l,
                "diff": round(avg_f - avg_l, 4),
            }
    return dynamic_range


def load_gates(checkpoint_dir, gate_type, hidden_dim, num_layers):
    """Load gate networks and trained parameters from checkpoint."""
    if gate_type == "threadgate":
        turn_embedding = TurnEmbedding()
        gates = nn.ModuleList([
            GateNetwork(hidden_dim, turn_embedding, init_bias=5.0)
            for _ in range(num_layers)
        ])
    else:
        turn_embedding = None
        gates = nn.ModuleList([
            UniformGateNetwork(hidden_dim, init_bias=5.0)
            for _ in range(num_layers)
        ])

    gate_path = os.path.join(checkpoint_dir, "gate_params.pt")
    if not os.path.exists(gate_path):
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Gate parameters not found: {gate_path}")
    gate_state = torch.load(gate_path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
    gates.load_state_dict(gate_state["gates"])
    if gate_type == "threadgate" and "turn_embedding" in gate_state:
        turn_embedding.load_state_dict(gate_state["turn_embedding"])

    return gates, turn_embedding


def register_gating_hooks(model, gates, gate_type, turn_embedding=None):
    """Register forward hooks on transformer layers for residual gating."""
    layers = _find_layers(model)
    hooks = []
    gate_values = {}
    turn_features_ref = [None]

    for i, layer in enumerate(layers):
        device = next(layer.parameters()).device
        gates[i].to(device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
    if gate_type == "threadgate" and turn_embedding is not None:
        device0 = next(layers[0].parameters()).device
        turn_embedding.to(device=device0, dtype=torch.bfloat16)

    def make_hook(layer_idx):
        def hook(module, input, output):
            if gate_type == "threadgate" and turn_features_ref[0] is None:
                return output

            layer_input = input[0]
            layer_output = output[0] if isinstance(output, tuple) else output

            if gate_type == "threadgate":
                g = gates[layer_idx](layer_input, turn_features_ref[0])
            else:
                g = gates[layer_idx](layer_input)

            f_x = layer_output - layer_input
            gated = layer_input + g * f_x
            gate_values[layer_idx] = g.detach()

            if isinstance(output, tuple):
                return (gated,) + output[1:]
            return gated
        return hook

    for i, layer in enumerate(layers):
        hooks.append(layer.register_forward_hook(make_hook(i)))

    return hooks, turn_features_ref, gate_values


def build_conversation(tokenizer, model, system_prompt, user_questions, device, max_new_tokens=100):
    """Generate a multi-turn conversation (same logic as Phase 1)."""
    messages = [{"role": "system", "content": system_prompt}]
    for q in user_questions:
        messages.append({"role": "user", "content": q})
        text = tokenizer.apply_chat_template(messages, tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True)
        input_ids = tokenizer(text, return_tensors="pt").input_ids.to(device)

        if input_ids.shape[1] > 1800:
            messages.pop()
            break

        with torch.no_grad():
            output = model.generate(input_ids, max_new_tokens=max_new_tokens, do_sample=False)

        new_tokens = output[0][input_ids.shape[1]:]
        response = tokenizer.decode(new_tokens, skip_special_tokens=True).strip()
        messages.append({"role": "assistant", "content": response})

    return messages


def measure_gar_per_turn(model, tokenizer, measurer, messages, device, turn_features_ref, gate_type, gar_variant="ours", gate_values_ref=None, gate_profile=False):
    """Measure GAR at each assistant turn with gating active."""
    full_text = tokenizer.apply_chat_template(messages, tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=False)
    input_ids = tokenizer(full_text, return_tensors="pt").input_ids.squeeze(0)

    if input_ids.shape[0] > 2048:
        input_ids = input_ids[:2048]

    boundaries = detect_turn_boundaries(input_ids, tokenizer, gar_variant=gar_variant)
    goal_positions = boundaries["goal_token_positions"]
    assistant_positions = boundaries["assistant_last_token_positions"]

    if not goal_positions or not assistant_positions:
        return None

    if gate_type == "threadgate":
        tf = build_turn_features(input_ids, tokenizer)
        turn_features_ref[0] = {
            "turn_distance": tf["turn_distance"].to(device),
            "turn_index": tf["turn_index"].to(device),
        }

    input_ids_batch = input_ids.unsqueeze(0).to(device)

    with measurer.measure():
        with torch.no_grad():
            model(input_ids_batch, output_attentions=True)

    per_turn_gates = None
    if gate_profile and gate_values_ref:
        per_turn_gates = _extract_per_turn_gates(gate_values_ref, boundaries["turns"])

    turn_features_ref[0] = None

    gar_per_turn = []
    normalized_gar_per_turn = []
    visible_tokens_per_turn = []
    num_goal_tokens = len(goal_positions)

    if gar_variant == "dongre":
        # Dongre: query = all response tokens per turn
        for turn_token_positions in boundaries["assistant_all_token_positions"]:
            result = measurer.compute_gar(goal_positions, turn_token_positions)
            raw_gar = result["mean_gar"]
            gar_per_turn.append(raw_gar)

            last_pos = turn_token_positions[-1]
            num_visible = last_pos + 1
            visible_tokens_per_turn.append(num_visible)

            if num_goal_tokens > 0:
                norm_gar = raw_gar * num_visible / num_goal_tokens
            else:
                norm_gar = 0.0
            normalized_gar_per_turn.append(norm_gar)
    else:
        # Ours: query = last token per assistant turn
        for pos in assistant_positions:
            result = measurer.compute_gar(goal_positions, [pos])
            raw_gar = result["mean_gar"]
            gar_per_turn.append(raw_gar)

            num_visible = pos + 1
            visible_tokens_per_turn.append(num_visible)

            if num_goal_tokens > 0:
                norm_gar = raw_gar * num_visible / num_goal_tokens
            else:
                norm_gar = 0.0
            normalized_gar_per_turn.append(norm_gar)

    result = {
        "gar_per_turn": gar_per_turn,
        "normalized_gar_per_turn": normalized_gar_per_turn,
        "visible_tokens_per_turn": visible_tokens_per_turn,
    }
    if per_turn_gates is not None:
        result["per_turn_gates"] = per_turn_gates
    return result


def plot_gar_comparison(baseline_gar, trained_gar, output_path, gate_type):
    """Plot baseline vs trained GAR curves."""
    min_turns = min(len(baseline_gar), len(trained_gar))
    turns_x = list(range(1, min_turns + 1))
    b = baseline_gar[:min_turns]
    t = trained_gar[:min_turns]

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5.5))
    ax.plot(turns_x, b, "r-s", linewidth=2, markersize=6, label="Baseline (no gate)")
    ax.plot(turns_x, t, "b-o", linewidth=2, markersize=6, label=f"Trained ({gate_type})")

    b_mid = float(np.mean(b[2:8]) if len(b) >= 8 else np.mean(b[2:]))
    t_mid = float(np.mean(t[2:8]) if len(t) >= 8 else np.mean(t[2:]))
    ax.axhline(y=b_mid, color="red", linestyle="--", alpha=0.4, label=f"Baseline mid: {b_mid:.4f}")
    ax.axhline(y=t_mid, color="blue", linestyle="--", alpha=0.4, label=f"Trained mid: {t_mid:.4f}")

    recovery_pp = (t_mid - b_mid) * 100
    ax.set_xlabel("Turn Index", fontsize=12)
    ax.set_ylabel("GAR (Goal Attention Ratio)", fontsize=12)
    ax.set_title(f"GAR Recovery: {gate_type} (mid-turn recovery: {recovery_pp:+.1f}pp)", fontsize=11)
    ax.legend(fontsize=9)
    ax.set_xticks(turns_x)
    ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

    fig.savefig(output_path, dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.close()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Evaluate trained gated model GAR recovery")
    parser.add_argument("--checkpoint-dir", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--gate-type", required=True, choices=["threadgate", "uniform"])
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", default="/root/turn_residual_gating/results/")
    parser.add_argument("--baseline-results", default="/root/turn_residual_gating/results/phase1_gar_results.json")
    parser.add_argument("--model-name", default=MODEL_NAME)
    parser.add_argument("--conversations-path", default=None, help="Path to standard_conversations.json for fixed conversations")
    parser.add_argument("--gar-variant", default="ours", choices=["ours", "dongre"],
                        help="GAR definition variant: ours (system+first_user goal, last token query) or dongre (system-only goal, all response tokens query)")
    parser.add_argument("--gate-profile", action="store_true",
                        help="Enable per-turn gate value profiling")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    os.makedirs(args.output_dir, exist_ok=True)
    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    print(f"Device: {device}")
    print(f"Gate type: {args.gate_type}")
    print(f"GAR variant: {args.gar_variant}")
    print(f"Checkpoint: {args.checkpoint_dir}")

    # Load base model with eager attention (required for GAR measurement)
    print("Loading base model (eager attention)...")
    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(args.model_name)
    base_model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
        args.model_name,
        torch_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
        device_map="auto",
        attn_implementation="eager",
    )
    base_model.eval()

    # Apply LoRA if present
    lora_path = os.path.join(args.checkpoint_dir, "lora")
    if os.path.isdir(lora_path):
        print("Loading LoRA adapter...")
        from peft import PeftModel
        base_model = PeftModel.from_pretrained(base_model, lora_path)
        base_model.eval()
    else:
        print("No LoRA directory found, using base model weights")

    # Load or generate conversations
    if args.conversations_path and os.path.exists(args.conversations_path):
        print(f"\nLoading fixed conversations from {args.conversations_path}")
        with open(args.conversations_path) as f:
            conv_data = json.load(f)
        conversations = [c["messages"] for c in conv_data]
        conversations_source = "fixed"
        for i, c in enumerate(conv_data):
            num_turns = c.get("num_turns", sum(1 for m in c["messages"] if m["role"] == "assistant"))
            print(f"  Conversation {i+1}/{len(conv_data)}: {num_turns} assistant turns")
    else:
        print("\nGenerating conversations...")
        conversations = []
        for i, (sys_prompt, user_qs) in enumerate(zip(SYSTEM_PROMPTS, CONVERSATIONS_DATA)):
            print(f"  Conversation {i+1}/{len(SYSTEM_PROMPTS)}: {sys_prompt[:50]}...")
            messages = build_conversation(tokenizer, base_model, sys_prompt, user_qs, device)
            num_turns = sum(1 for m in messages if m["role"] == "assistant")
            print(f"    {num_turns} assistant turns")
            conversations.append(messages)
        conversations_source = "generated"

    # Load gates and register hooks
    print("\nLoading gate parameters...")
    hidden_dim = base_model.config.hidden_size
    num_layers = base_model.config.num_hidden_layers
    gates, turn_embedding = load_gates(args.checkpoint_dir, args.gate_type, hidden_dim, num_layers)

    hooks, turn_features_ref, gate_values = register_gating_hooks(
        base_model, gates, args.gate_type, turn_embedding
    )

    # Create GARMeasurer on the underlying HF model
    hf_model = _find_hf_model(base_model)
    measurer = GARMeasurer(hf_model)

    # Measure GAR with gating active
    print("\nMeasuring GAR...")
    all_gar_curves = []
    all_norm_curves = []
    all_visible_curves = []
    all_gate_profiles = []
    for i, messages in enumerate(conversations):
        result = measure_gar_per_turn(
            base_model, tokenizer, measurer, messages, device,
            turn_features_ref, args.gate_type, gar_variant=args.gar_variant,
            gate_values_ref=gate_values if args.gate_profile else None,
            gate_profile=args.gate_profile,
        )
        if result:
            gar_curve = result["gar_per_turn"]
            norm_curve = result["normalized_gar_per_turn"]
            vis_curve = result["visible_tokens_per_turn"]
            print(f"  Conv {i+1} GAR:  {[f'{g:.4f}' for g in gar_curve]}")
            print(f"  Conv {i+1} nGAR: {[f'{g:.4f}' for g in norm_curve]}")
            all_gar_curves.append(gar_curve)
            all_norm_curves.append(norm_curve)
            all_visible_curves.append(vis_curve)
            if "per_turn_gates" in result:
                all_gate_profiles.append(result["per_turn_gates"])
        else:
            print(f"  Conv {i+1}: WARNING - could not measure GAR")

    for h in hooks:
        h.remove()

    if not all_gar_curves:
        print("ERROR: No valid GAR measurements")
        sys.exit(1)

    # Statistics
    min_turns = min(len(c) for c in all_gar_curves)
    aligned = [c[:min_turns] for c in all_gar_curves]
    avg_gar = np.mean(aligned, axis=0).tolist()

    aligned_norm = [c[:min_turns] for c in all_norm_curves]
    avg_norm_gar = np.mean(aligned_norm, axis=0).tolist()

    aligned_vis = [c[:min_turns] for c in all_visible_curves]
    avg_visible = [int(x) for x in np.mean(aligned_vis, axis=0).tolist()]

    turn1_gar = avg_gar[0]
    mid_turns_gar = float(np.mean(avg_gar[2:8]) if len(avg_gar) >= 8 else np.mean(avg_gar[2:]))
    mid_turns_norm_gar = float(np.mean(avg_norm_gar[2:8]) if len(avg_norm_gar) >= 8 else np.mean(avg_norm_gar[2:]))

    # Baseline comparison
    baseline_gar = None
    gar_recovery = None
    baseline_mid = None
    if os.path.exists(args.baseline_results):
        with open(args.baseline_results) as f:
            baseline = json.load(f)
        baseline_gar = baseline["avg_gar_per_turn"]
        baseline_mid = baseline["mid_turns_avg_gar"]
        gar_recovery = mid_turns_gar - baseline_mid
        print(f"\nBaseline mid-turn GAR: {baseline_mid:.4f}")
        print(f"Trained mid-turn GAR:  {mid_turns_gar:.4f}")
        print(f"GAR recovery:          {gar_recovery*100:+.2f}pp")
    else:
        print(f"\nWARNING: Baseline not found at {args.baseline_results}")

    # Save results
    ckpt_name = os.path.basename(args.checkpoint_dir.rstrip("/"))
    if args.gar_variant == "dongre":
        ckpt_name += "_dongre"
    results = {
        "checkpoint_dir": args.checkpoint_dir,
        "gate_type": args.gate_type,
        "gar_variant": args.gar_variant,
        "model": args.model_name,
        "num_conversations": len(all_gar_curves),
        "num_turns": min_turns,
        "gar_curves": all_gar_curves,
        "avg_gar_per_turn": avg_gar,
        "turn1_avg_gar": turn1_gar,
        "mid_turns_avg_gar": mid_turns_gar,
        "baseline_mid_turns_avg_gar": baseline_mid,
        "gar_recovery_pp": gar_recovery * 100 if gar_recovery is not None else None,
        "normalized_gar_curves": [c[:min_turns] for c in all_norm_curves],
        "avg_normalized_gar_per_turn": avg_norm_gar,
        "mid_turns_avg_normalized_gar": mid_turns_norm_gar,
        "avg_visible_tokens_per_turn": avg_visible,
        "conversations_source": conversations_source,
    }

    if args.gate_profile and all_gate_profiles:
        gate_profile_per_turn = {}
        for i, profile in enumerate(all_gate_profiles):
            gate_profile_per_turn[f"conv_{i}"] = profile
        gate_dr = _compute_gate_dynamic_range(all_gate_profiles, num_layers)
        results["gate_profile_per_turn"] = gate_profile_per_turn
        results["gate_dynamic_range"] = gate_dr

    results_path = os.path.join(args.output_dir, f"{ckpt_name}_gar.json")
    with open(results_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(results, f, indent=2)
    print(f"\nResults saved to {results_path}")

    if baseline_gar:
        plot_path = os.path.join(args.output_dir, f"{ckpt_name}_gar_comparison.png")
        plot_gar_comparison(baseline_gar, avg_gar, plot_path, args.gate_type)
        print(f"Plot saved to {plot_path}")

    variant_label = f"GAR-{args.gar_variant}" if args.gar_variant == "dongre" else "GAR-ours"
    print(f"\n{'='*50}")
    print(f"Phase 2 GAR Evaluation ({args.gate_type}, {variant_label})")
    print(f"{'='*50}")
    print(f"Turn 1 avg GAR:     {turn1_gar:.4f}")
    print(f"Mid-turns avg GAR:  {mid_turns_gar:.4f}")
    print(f"Mid-turns avg nGAR: {mid_turns_norm_gar:.4f}")
    if gar_recovery is not None:
        print(f"GAR recovery:       {gar_recovery*100:+.2f}pp")

    if args.gate_profile and "gate_dynamic_range" in results:
        print(f"\nGate Dynamic Range (top layers by |diff|):")
        sorted_layers = sorted(
            results["gate_dynamic_range"].items(),
            key=lambda x: abs(x[1]["diff"]),

            print(f"  {lk}: turn1={dr['turn1']:.4f}  {tn_key}={dr[tn_key]:.4f}  diff={dr['diff']:+.4f}")

        if first_vals and last_vals:

    """Register forward hooks on transformer layers for residual gating."""
    layers = _find_layers(model)
    hooks = []
    gate_values = {}
    turn_features_ref = [None]

    for i, layer in enumerate(layers):
        device = next(layer.parameters()).device
        gates[i].to(device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
    if gate_type == "threadgate" and turn_embedding is not None:
        device0 = next(layers[0].parameters()).device
        turn_embedding.to(device=device0, dtype=torch.bfloat16)

    def make_hook(layer_idx):
        def hook(module, input, output):
            if gate_type == "threadgate" and turn_features_ref[0] is None:
                return output

            layer_input = input[0]
            layer_output = output[0] if isinstance(output, tuple) else output

            if gate_type == "threadgate":
                g = gates[layer_idx](layer_input, turn_features_ref[0])
            else:
                g = gates[layer_idx](layer_input)

            f_x = layer_output - layer_input
            gated = layer_input + g * f_x
            gate_values[layer_idx] = g.detach()

            if isinstance(output, tuple):
                return (gated,) + output[1:]
            return gated
        return hook

    for i, layer in enumerate(layers):
        hooks.append(layer.register_forward_hook(make_hook(i)))

def plot_gar_comparison(baseline_gar, trained_gar, output_path, gate_type):
    """Plot baseline vs trained GAR curves."""
    min_turns = min(len(baseline_gar), len(trained_gar))
    turns_x = list(range(1, min_turns + 1))
    b = baseline_gar[:min_turns]
    t = trained_gar[:min_turns]

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5.5))
    ax.plot(turns_x, b, "r-s", linewidth=2, markersize=6, label="Baseline (no gate)")
    ax.plot(turns_x, t, "b-o", linewidth=2, markersize=6, label=f"Trained ({gate_type})")

    b_mid = float(np.mean(b[2:8]) if len(b) >= 8 else np.mean(b[2:]))
    t_mid = float(np.mean(t[2:8]) if len(t) >= 8 else np.mean(t[2:]))
    ax.axhline(y=b_mid, color="red", linestyle="--", alpha=0.4, label=f"Baseline mid: {b_mid:.4f}")
    ax.axhline(y=t_mid, color="blue", linestyle="--", alpha=0.4, label=f"Trained mid: {t_mid:.4f}")

    recovery_pp = (t_mid - b_mid) * 100
    ax.set_xlabel("Turn Index", fontsize=12)
    ax.set_ylabel("GAR (Goal Attention Ratio)", fontsize=12)
    ax.set_title(f"GAR Recovery: {gate_type} (mid-turn recovery: {recovery_pp:+.1f}pp)", fontsize=11)
    ax.legend(fontsize=9)
    ax.set_xticks(turns_x)
    ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

    fig.savefig(output_path, dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.close()
